core_obligations: Setup: U locally Noetherian and f lfp by the cited Morphisms of Stacks lemmas (proof lines 3811-3816).

(4)=>(2): replace V by members of an etale covering of W = U x_X V to get h: V -> U; x^*F = pullback of h^*(f^*F|_{U_etale}) by compare-quasi-coherent; finite presentation localizes (proof lines 3817-3832).
(2)=>(1) immediate from definitions; (1)=>(3) by local-pullback plus the Cohomology of Spaces coherent-Noetherian lemma; (3)=>(4) trivial (proof lines 3835-3841).
proof_roadmap: Prove the descending implication (4)=>(2) by localization.
difficulty_reason: The substantive implication (4) => (2) descends the finite presentation through the flat lfp surjection: fppf localization, etale refinement to obtain h: V -> U over X, compatibility of x^*F with h^*(f^*F|) via the compare-quasi-coherent lemma, and local finite presentation of the pullback. The remaining implications are definition-level or one lemma each.
